title: First Meeting
story: Two strangers found themselves at the same rooftop gathering in the city. A shared laugh over a spilled drink became the beginning of something wonderful.

title: The First Date
story: A walk through the park, then coffee that stretched into dinner. Neither of them wanted the evening to end.

title: Making it Official
story: Snowed in together, watching old movies and talking about everything. That week, they both knew.

title: Weathering the Storm
story: The world paused, but their love grew stronger. They cooked terrible meals, learned card games, and fell even more deeply in love.

title: The Proposal
story: On a quiet evening by the water, with the golden light fading, he got down on one knee. She said yes before he could finish the question.

title: Married! 🎉
story: And now, surrounded by the people they love most, they begin the next great adventure together.
